scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @intelliloop/domain && npm run build -w @intelliloop/contracts && npm run build -w @intelliloop/demo-fixtures
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @intelliloop/api" "npm run dev -w @intelliloop/web"
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @intelliloop/api" "npm run dev -w @intelliloop/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @intelliloop/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @intelliloop/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:api: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.api.config.ts
scripts.verify:ui-handoff: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @intelliloop/web && vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts apps/web/test/foundation.test.tsx apps/web/test/guided-demo-journey.test.tsx apps/web/test/local-project-pilot.test.tsx && npm run build -w @intelliloop/web && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs apps/web/e2e/golden-flow.spec.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run build -w @intelliloop/web
scripts.evidence:repo-safety: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run check:repo-safety
scripts.evidence:privacy: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run check:privacy
scripts.evidence:twin-code-map: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run check:twin-code-map
scripts.evidence:reconcile: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run check:reconcile
scripts.evidence:citations: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run check:reconcile
scripts.evidence:openai-eval: npm run build:packages && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:reconcile && npm run check:openai-eval
scripts.evidence:readiness-passport: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @intelliloop/api && npm run check:readiness-passport
scripts.evidence:retail-fixture: npm run build -w @intelliloop/demo-fixtures && npm run check:retail-fixture
scripts.evidence:golden-flow: npm run build:packages && npm run check:golden-flow
scripts.evidence:accessibility: npm run build:packages && npm run check:accessibility
scripts.evidence:demo-gate: npm run build && npm run check:repo-safety && npm run check:privacy && node scripts/generate-demo-gate-evidence.mjs
scripts.evidence:release-security: npm run check:repo-safety && npm run check:privacy && node scripts/generate-release-security-evidence.mjs --refresh
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:repo-safety && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:twin-code-map && npm run check:reconcile && npm run check:openai-eval && npm run check:readiness-passport && npm run check:readiness-passport-docs && npm run check:retail-fixture && npm run check:ai-safety-docs && npm run check:metrics && npm run check:evidence-replay && npm run check:advisory-disagreement && npm run check:remediation-preview && npm run check:docs
